Tummy tuck in Barcelona

Los problemas de flacidez en el área abdominal se vuelven muy complejos de tratar con dieta y ejercicios una vez que la piel pierde tonicidad y se acumula en exceso. Por ello, en Clínica Belba nos especializamos en la tummy tuck in Barcelona and we have highly experienced specialists to perform this type of aesthetic procedure.

Al estirar la piel del abdomen se puede recuperar la comodidad al vestir, caminar y ejercitarse. Es una alternativa para lograr la figura deseada luego de un proceso de pérdida de peso o embarazos, por ejemplo.  

What is an abdominal lipectomy in Barcelona?

Abdominal surgery, also known as abdominal contouring in Barcelona, is a surgical procedure to remove sagging abdominal skin by excising excess skin and fat. The procedure tightens the tissue to remove the folds and wrinkles that make the abdomen look droopy.

The lipectomía abdominal en Barcelona has an aesthetic purpose that can help people boost their self-esteem and enhance the appearance of the body. If needed, abdominal plastic surgery can also restore muscle tone to the abdomen.

Tipos de Abdominoplastia en Barcelona

  • Minilipectomia: La minidermolipectomía allows the lower abdomen to be tightened, that is, the loose skin below the navel, which is very common, especially after pregnancy. If there is cicatriz de cesárea previa se puede corregir la misma y realizar el estiramiento al mismo tiempo. Si existe un pequeño acúmulo de grasa en esta zona puede asociarse liposuction of the flanks to define the waist and of the periumbilical fat.

  • Técnica de Saldaña: It is indicated for people who have an abdominal apron but also have excess fat. This technique allows us to combine abdominal liposuction with tightening of the excess skin. The advantage is that, thanks to the liposuction, adelgazar la pared abdominal y mejorar mucho el contorno corporal.
  • Lipectomia con trasposición de ombligo: It is very common in patients after pregnancy with marked dilatación abdominal and after major weight loss, in very slim patients. In these cases the separation of the rectus abdominis muscles is repaired, the skin is tightened by trimming the excess at the lowest possible level so that the scar is hidden by underwear, and the navel is transposed.

When is an abdominal lipectomy recommended?

Si quieres hacerte una surgery to correct a sagging abdomen in Barcelona, you should know that this procedure can be performed on both women and men who have completed their weight loss and now need an operation to remove fat and hanging skin.

En Clínica Belba recomendamos la Tummy tuck for those who wish to recover their silhouette and body contour. We have the best tummy tuck surgeon in Barcelona

Expected results of abdominal wall surgery

Una particularidad de la abdominal surgery in Barcelona is that its results are very noticeable from the very first moment. After full recovery, and once the swelling has gone down, the abdomen will look flatter.

The patient will notice a reduction in abdominal fat and reducción del volumen del abdomen, así como la eliminación de la flacidez, pliegues o arrugas. Notarán además que los tejidos que antes estaban muy débiles, ahora se encuentran totalmente tonificados.

Among the results of a dermolipectomy in Barcelona, an increase in self-esteem is also expected, as patients feel better about their body image. The results can be permanent if the patient eats well and exercises.

Riesgos de una lipectomía del abdomen

With abdominal lipectomy in Barcelona and the removal of excess abdominal skin and fat there are also risks, as with any other surgery.

The most common risks are infections, difficulty healing, oedema and venous thrombosis. However, if the patient is responsible with their post-operative care, these risks are reduced to a minimum.

abdominal surgery in Barcelona

Make an appointment

Pre-operative preparation for abdominal wall surgery

To undergo this body plastic surgery, the patient must prepare for the operation, with the follow-up of the surgeon and the rest of the Clínica Belba staff. The aim is to reduce the risks of the procedure and create the best conditions for the patient to achieve the desired results.

Consultation before abdominal surgery

 This consultation consists of an interview with the surgeon and a physical assessment of the abdominal area. At this first meeting the patient's medical history is taken, the procedure is discussed in detail and expectations are clarified.

After the consultation, the doctor asks the patient for some laboratory tests and examinations to gain a thorough understanding of their current state of health. The doctor also gives instructions on prohibited medications, permitted habits and the diet to follow before the surgery to correct a sagging abdomen.

Indicaciones de preoperatorio en una operación de la pared abdominal

 If the patient is in good health and their clinical tests are favourable, the pre-operative phase will be short and simple. Before the operation, the patient must avoid alcohol and smoking and take care with their eating and personal hygiene habits.

You may need to attend further consultations with the surgeon. It is advisable to prepare your home for rest and recovery, arrange transport to the clinic and, once discharged, to have someone at home with you for the first few weeks.

Abdominal wall surgery procedure

El procedimiento para realizar body plastic surgery in Barcelona to successfully tighten the abdominal skin includes detailed surgical planning, patient assessments, the choice of appropriate techniques and patient care.

Technique used in abdominal surgery in Barcelona

In surgery for the reducción del volumen of the abdomen, a technique of exposing and tightening the abdominal wall muscles is used to narrow the waist area and flatten the tissues.

The surgeon may relocate tissue and remove excess skin and fat. In some cases, this operation is performed together with liposuction for better results.

Anestesia empleada en la dermolipectomia en Barcelona

The operación de Tummy tuck in Barcelona is a procedure carried out under general anaesthesia administered by a specialist who will accompany the plastic surgeon.

Duración de la operación de abdomen en Barcelona

 The operation to reduce the abdomen can last up to 4 or 5 hours when the tissue correction is complete. If the procedure is smaller, for example to remove sagging around the navel, the surgeon may need only two hours to complete the operation.

Post-operative care after abdominal surgery

 Es la fase crucial de rehabilitación del paciente de esta body plastic surgery. It is characterised by rest, cleaning of the incisions and reduced physical activity. It is very important that the patient follows the instructions given by the plastic surgeon y respete el cronograma de citas de control.

Recovery time after abdominal wall surgery

Compared with other aesthetic surgical procedures, abdominal surgery involves a longer recovery process. This is because skin and muscle tissue is tightened during the procedure, so the area needs more time for the swelling to go down and to heal.

The patient may need two to four weeks to return to work and, during rest, cannot exercise or make movements that put tension on the incisions.

Cuidados luego de la lipectomía abdominal

During the recovery phase of body plastic surgery in Barcelona, the patient must wear an abdominal binder for no less than six weeks, possibly longer if the surgeon considers it prudent.

Walking several times a day is recommended, as is having help to get up, lie down and wash during the first few weeks. The surgeon will explain the signs of infection, the best methods for cleaning the wounds, the medication protocol and the follow-up appointments.

It is normal to feel pain in the days following the operation, and the area will be swollen. Painkillers will be very helpful in reducing discomfort.

The best abdominoplasty surgeons in Barcelona

At Clínica Belba we are a widely recognised aesthetic medicine centre, distinguished by the quality of our facilities and equipment. Patients who come to us are looked after by very attentive and respectful staff.

Trabajamos de la mano con el Dr. Mike Dewever y Dr. Félix Chavarría, two surgeons who specialise in many types of treatment, including Tummy tuck and other body-contouring techniques, together with cutting-edge technology to offer the best to our patients.

Frequently Asked Questions:

What is the price of a tummy tuck in Barcelona?

If you want to know what the cost of body plastic surgery in Barcelona, you should know that the Tummy tuck It's a treatment tailored to the patient's needs, and the price reflects the personalization of the approach chosen by the surgeon to achieve effective skin tightening.

At Clinica Belba, we create a personalized quote, so the The price of a tummy tuck in Barcelona. will be adapted to the therapeutic plan designed for the surgery. Consult our tummy tuck cost Barcelona and discover how we can help you achieve your aesthetic goals with safety and excellence.

tummy tuck Barcelona price

What scars does surgery to remove excess skin leave?

The scar is usually located above the pubis. After the first 6 months it will be much lighter and flatter.

abdominoplastia precio barcelona

When is an abdominal lipectomy in Barcelona contraindicated?

Se contraindica cuando los pacientes, sean hombres o mujeres, tengan problemas de obesidad o que estén en pleno proceso de pérdida de peso.

Tampoco se pueden operar personas con diabetes, quienes tengan alguna enfermedad cardio pulmonar, problemas de coagulación o propensión a desarrollar infecciones.

What is a good time for abdominal surgery?

The most suitable time is when the patient is at their ideal weight and has already reached their weight-loss goals. For women, once they have finished breastfeeding.

How painful is abdominal surgery?

Abdominoplasty can be a painful procedure, as it involves manipulation of the tissues and removal of skin. The strongest pain is felt when the person has to move, because the operation involves tightening the muscles of the abdominal area.

Por ello, se recomienda el máximo reposo. En el descanso se debe flexionar un poco el torso para evitar que duela la herida al tensarse los músculos.

How long does pain last after an abdominoplasty?

Pain after an abdominoplasty can last from the first three days to several weeks. However, most people experience the most intense pain only during the first few days after surgery.

The pain usually eases over time and disappears completely after a few weeks.

Is sensation lost after abdominal wall surgery?

Es normal que con la disminución de grasa abdominal exista una pérdida de sensibilidad en la zona cercana a las incisiones, pero es solo temporal.

How many times can an abdominoplasty be performed?

There is no anatomical limit to performing a second abdominal rejuvenation or abdominal volume reduction surgery. However, specialists must assess a number of points for this, as it is not always possible to remove all the skin again.

On the other hand, there are cases in which a second operation is necessary to correct flaws from the first.

mainEntity.name: ¿Qué cicatrices deja la operación piel sobrante?

acceptedAnswer.text:
La cicatriz suele ubicarse por encima del pubis. Después de los primeros 6 meses será mucho más clara y aplanada.

abdominoplastia precio barcelona

mainEntity.name: ¿Cuándo se contraindica una lipectomía abdominal Barcelona?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Se contraindica cuando los pacientes, sean hombres o mujeres, tengan problemas de obesidad o que estén en pleno proceso de pérdida de peso.

Tampoco se pueden operar personas con diabetes, quienes tengan alguna enfermedad cardio pulmonar, problemas de coagulación o propensión a desarrollar infecciones.

mainEntity.name: ¿Qué momento es bueno para una cirugía abdominal?

acceptedAnswer.text: El momento más adecuado será cuando el paciente tenga el peso ideal y ya haya alcanzado sus metas al adelgazar. En mujeres cuando ya han terminado de amamantar.

La abdominoplastia puede ser un procedimiento doloroso, ya que implica la manipulación de los tejidos y la extracción de piel. El dolor más fuerte se siente cuando la persona deba moverse, debido a que la operación implica el tensado de los músculos de la zona abdominal.

Por ello, se recomienda el máximo reposo. En el descanso se debe flexionar un poco el torso para evitar que duela la herida al tensarse los músculos.

mainEntity.name: ¿Cuánto tiempo dura el dolor luego de una abdominoplastia?

acceptedAnswer.text:
El dolor después de una abdominoplastia puede durar desde los primeros tres días hasta varias semanas. Sin embargo, la mayoría de las personas experimentan el dolor más intenso solo durante los primeros días tras la cirugía.

El dolor suele aliviarse con el tiempo y desaparecer por completo al cabo de unas pocas semanas.

mainEntity.name: ¿Se pierde la sensibilidad luego de la cirugía de la pared abdominal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Es normal que con la disminución de grasa abdominal exista una pérdida de sensibilidad en la zona cercana a las incisiones, pero es solo temporal.

mainEntity.name: ¿Cuántas veces se puede hacer la abdominoplastia?

acceptedAnswer.text:
No existe una limitación anatómica para realizar una segunda cirugía de rejuvenecimiento abdominal o de reducción del volumen del abdomen. Sin embargo, para esto los especialistas deberán valorar una serie de puntos. Y es que no siempre es posible extirpar de nuevo toda la piel.

Por otro lado, hay casos en los que se hace necesario una segunda intervención para corregir fallos de la primera.
